title: Evil Megacorp Auth
tagline: FaceScan Auth Login / Sign Up system, minting stylized NFTs as access keys.
description:
Login/Signup solution for Evil Megacorp

Signup by generating NFT from a facescan. Metadata would contain encrypted landmarks and stylized Image of your face connected to a barcode with you own unique number.

Login by scanning your face plus connecting wallet / proving NFT ownership.
how_its_made: Built with Scaffold ETH 2/Hardhat. I have used Open Zeppelin Wizard to put the smart contract together. Smart Contract is Governor ready, since users would have variety of clearance levels to access features within the corp and vote. Contract deployed on Sepolia and Flow testnet to cheepskate the fees and speed up. App uploaded to Vercel. Facescan tech by MediaPipe Landmark recognition.
